items.en: a tannic acid that is extracted from black catechu as a white crystalline substance

items.en: any of several North American composite subshrubs of the genera Artemis or Seriphidium

items.en: a gliding joint between the distal ends of the tibia and fibula and the proximal end of the talus
items.reason: 来源将 ankle 描述为 gliding joint，需独立核对关节类型，暂不把译文修复当来源正确。

items.en: (of meat) full of sinews; especially impossible to chew a consisting of tendons or resembling a tendon
items.reason: 同一条内仍残留无点a词性边界，需按确切原行恢复两个义项而非翻成混合长句。

items.en: a radioactive transuranic element synthesized by bombarding curium with carbon ions; 7 isotopes are known

items.en: hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella

items.reason: 将整个protactinium元素称为short-lived可能过度概括，需核实与同位素语境。

items.en: A colloquial or humorous appellation for a negro; sometimes, the offspring of a black person and a mulatto; a zambo.

items.en: large mackerel with long pointed snout; important food and game fish of the eastern Atlantic coast southward to Brazil
items.reason: 原文eastern Atlantic coast与southward to Brazil在地理上可疑，需核对鱼种和来源。

items.en: a semiaquatic plant that grows in soft wet land; most are monocots: sedge, sphagnum, grasses, cattails, etc; possibly heath
items.reason: 沼泽植物定义在monocots列举中含sphagnum，需区分例外及旧分类表达。

items.en: extremely poisonous usually white fungus with a prominent cup-shaped base; differs from edible Agaricus only in its white gills
items.reason: 毒蘑菇定义的only in its white gills具有过度简化的鉴别断言，不能作为可靠识别方法呈现。

items.en: annual native to South America having underground stolons bearing edible starchy tubers; widely cultivated as a garden vegetable; vines are poisonous
items.reason: potato为多年生植物而常作一年生栽培，原文直接称annual须核对植物与栽培用法。

items.en: a yellow trivalent metallic element of the rare earth group; occurs in monazite and bastnasite in association with cerium and lanthanum and praseodymium
items.reason: neodymium元素原文称yellow，需核对元素外观，不能只修稀土乱码。

items.reason: manta/devil ray相关条目声称尾基有毒组织，需核对具体物种及毒刺结构。

items.reason: baryon被称elementary particle与现代复合粒子定义冲突，需要来源语义更新。

items.en: a lustrous grey strong metallic element resembling titanium; it is used in nuclear reactors as a neutron absorber; it occurs in baddeleyite but is obtained chiefly from zircon
items.reason: zirconium被描述为中子吸收体，疑与锆低中子吸收性质混淆，需独立核查。

items.en: a radioactive gaseous element formed by the disintegration of radium; the heaviest of the inert gasses; occurs naturally (especially in areas over granite) and is considered a hazard to health

items.en: A whitish woolly plant (Teucrium Polium) of the order Labiatae, found throughout the Mediterranean region. The name, with sundry prefixes, is sometimes given to other related species of the same genus.

items.reason: arsenic原文称metallic而现代分类为metalloid，需独立编辑源义项。

items.en: A line in the Scriptures; specifically (Hebrew Scriptures), one of the rhythmic lines in the poetical books and passages of the Old Treatment, as written in the oldest Hebrew manuscripts and in the Revised Version of the English Bible.

items.en: the acetylated derivative of salicylic acid; used as an analgesic anti-inflammatory drug (trade names Bayer, Empirin, and St. Joseph) usually taken in tablet form; used as an antipyretic; slows clotting of the blood by poisoning platelets
items.reason: aspirin以poisoning platelets概括抗血小板作用不准确，需更新药理描述而非机械翻译。
